person.headline: 👨‍💻 Senior engineer looking for role in AI project
person.summary:
Interested in:
 - roles: AI integration (LangChain, Flowise, OpenAI, etc.) or Senior frontend engineer
 - locations: UAE, Europe, Singapore
 - type: Remote or Dubai
---
Web developer with 9 years of experience  (JavaScript/TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Next.js, Node.js), crypto enthusiast (from 2018), dreamer 🙃
Now actively learning AI, agents/automations. 🤖

I am good at: startups/MVPs (focus on important, quick launch, modern tools, maybe no-code/low-code solutions), crypto/web3.
During my work I focus on problems and suggest how to solve them.
Can do team lead responsibilities.

Nationality: Belarus 🇧🇾
Have good IT education and Western thinking.

In my free time I like to visit tech meetups/conferences, like sports activities (mix of sport's gymnastics, yoga, calisthenics).

Also I can solve Rubik's cube for 20-30 seconds 😄

Lets talk;)
